review: Independent changed-material correctness, clean-code and boundary-safety follow-up of the ENTITY_CANDIDATE source findings

findings.title: The new NEED_PLACEMENT state does not yet exclude known scene-less or skip-only branches before entity getters
findings.evidence: check_candidate_reply accepts NEED_PLACEMENT when placement has not been read and the nonmobile/non-city-child candidate has FIXED_GIVEN=1. It does not require an actual placement-bearing role or a scene. After a legitimate NEED_FIXED, a CITY or direct CITY_BUILDING has FIXED=1, FIXED_GIVEN=1 and scene0, so a malformed NEED_PLACEMENT is accepted. The shared offer then invokes HEADING and ALIGN for that entity even though the original city/direct-building branch never called them. A known unflagged candidate after NEED_FIXED also passes the validator. The existing malformed-placement cases cover repetition and placement-before-fixed-facts, but not these known skip/scene-less roles.
findings.impact: The reply is used to invoke Core getters before the intended entity_candidate.state refusal. A scene-less invalid-shape test currently reaches its later TEST refusal after an unnecessary placement request. This is a precise new-state service-precondition gap, not a demand for Core to reproduce host physical broadphase decisions.
findings.minimum_correction: Reject NEED_PLACEMENT before any getter when no scene exists or the role is already a city, directly listed city building, or known unflagged ordinary candidate. Require an eligible mobile, city-child, or ordinary fixed branch with the necessary stage facts and placement not already supplied. Preserve the legitimate city-child case whose collision flags are intentionally read during placement, and preserve scene-less SKIP/NEED_FIXED paths. Do not reintroduce radius/skip arithmetic into Core or require geometry for the skip.
findings.minimum_validation: Extend the existing actual shared C-offer/dialogue controls: keep coherent mobile/fixed/city-child placement positives first, then offer malformed NEED_PLACEMENT for city, direct building and known unflagged/scene-less cases and assert entity_candidate.state before any added getter or collision. No known-bad native, 32-bit experiment, broad framework or repeated war is required.

closed_corrections.assessment: Corrected. The real offer is now mb_hostoffer.h, included by en_cllsn.c and the compiled C control. A nonmobile first offer has only the staged initial facts and scene0; the host can tallest-skip without reading the fixed flag, shape, position, heading or model. NEED_FIXED reads the fixed branch only when requested. A directly listed city building remains scene-less and reaches its explicit skip. The host radius closure is called only when the C kernel asks NEED_RADIUS; skipped/city/direct-building paths need no model, whereas branches requiring unavailable geometry refuse rather than inventing radius/model/miss.

Corrected. candidate_word_is_finite takes const float* and memcpy-classifies the raw word before any floating argument conversion. The focused C cases include a signaling-NaN pose. This closes the source-level issue; no x87/32-bit trapping experiment or native FP claim is made.

Corrected. A separate CAMPAIGN_ENTITY_CANDIDATE_IDENTITY is bound to entity_candidate and used for the new dialogue, while the closed entity_collision identity remains unchanged. The actual shared C expectation and the retained wrong-label mutant discriminate the new operation.

other_reviewed_delta_observations: C/Rust/Lua transport agrees on 44 facts, the two added stage flags and seven public states. Internal NEED_RADIUS is handled solely within the host with one checked retry and cannot become a public Core decision. TEST still carries only 12 or 16 finite candidate floats and is validated before caller pose use.

The known reference host requests placement only after its broadphase passes. NEED_UPDATED and NEED_NORMAL remain the real Core services, with supplied-state flags preventing repeat requests; the updated getter remains the original destructive shared-word operation. The new getter-log controls exercise the actual shared offer, rather than just the prior Rust transcription. The residual concerns malformed provider states that the reference host does not emit.

Pure base-state snapshots and stage markers are not a literal replay of every old getter call; the finite correctness claim concerns required data prerequisites, preserved physical calculations and enabled effectful services. Native equivalence remains to be measured on the corrected source.
